comparison.objective: Install a rack rail versus assemble a three-gear train on shafts.
comparison.physical_skill: Dual-prong compliant insertion, telescoping and screw fastening versus repeated shaft insertion with rotational tooth-phase search by contact.
comparison.success_condition: Four retained prongs and correct screws versus three fully seated gears with both adjacent pairs meshed.
comparison.reason: Both use insertion, but tooth-phase discovery and multi-gear meshing are meaningfully different from spring-latched structural attachment. Candidate force and thread tolerances are missing.
